packageRules.description: One weekly PR with every update; a Claude routine fixes it up (lockfiles, flake hashes, breaking changes) and merges it.

Hold the distro binaries' build container on Debian 12. Its glibc (2.36) is the newest the packaged binaries may need; Debian 13 builds need 2.39+ and fail the debian-12 and ubuntu-22.04 installs. Lift when those targets are dropped.
